In the foreground left is a black square device with a circular control interface and illegible text labels. In the foreground right is a translucent white square device with similar controls. In the background center stands a silver rectangular device resembling an early iPod Video/Classic, featuring a screen with a green-tinted interface and a click wheel below it.
